name: Machine rear delt fly
instructions: Sit facing the pad with your chest against it.
Set the handles so your arms reach them straight out in front at shoulder height.
Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Bring the handles back to the front with control.
cue: Chest on the pad, arms wide and back
mistakes: Bending the elbows to pull with the back instead.
Leaning away from the pad to swing the weight.
